_metadata.claim_boundary: Final holdout saved-output replay using only available frozen test450 artifacts. Reports aggregate generalization of a constrained two-agent variant; exact three-agent validation policy is not fully testable without a DeepSeek test450 structured-event artifact. No row-level holdout tuning or failure inspection is authorized.
_metadata.deviation_from_validation_policy: The validation result used three agents: GPT, Qwen v0.6 with recent patch, and DeepSeek v0.6. No DeepSeek test450 structured-event artifact is available on disk, and the Qwen test artifact is v0.5; therefore this is a constrained closest-available audit, not the exact three-agent policy.
_metadata.inspection_policy: aggregate scoring only; no test-row failure inspection or tuning
_metadata.model: panel: deterministic_rules_tool + gpt-4.1-mini + qwen3.6:35b; DeepSeek test450 artifact unavailable
_metadata.selector: exact-label unanimity across available GPT and Qwen structured-event agents; otherwise keep deterministic tool baseline
